dedupe_keys.name: us ready mix concrete environmental product declaration compilation

description: This compilation extracts concrete mixture properties and environmental indicators from US environmental product declarations. Geographic coverage is the United States. Pennsylvania State University researchers assembled strength classes, curing times, product components, declared units, plant locations and life-cycle impact measures from ASTM and NRMCA sources. Current Mendeley version 5 reports 47,413 declarations and provides CSV and XLSX files free under CC BY 4.0. Its April 2026 update adds application fields; the original article instead describes 39,213 declarations gathered in February–April 2023. Declarations have different issue dates and reference conditions, so the collection is not a uniform current inventory of every concrete product. These differences and extraction assumptions are limitations for direct comparisons. Modellers could parameterise embodied-impact or concrete-selection scenarios in infrastructure simulations. data-ec3-embodied-carbon-in-construction-calculator-epd-database and platform-openlca provide related resources. A Python extraction example is described in the article but is absent from the current release inventory. No declarations, spreadsheets or code were downloaded.
